reviews.title: Great app to have fun in free time.
reviews.pros:
- TikTok is a great app to make, share and see short videos.

- The suggested videos are curated according to the user taste.

- New filters gets often added for new trends.
reviews.cons: - When using TikTok, there is always a security concern, but other than that, an amazing application for entertainment.
reviews.overall: TikTok is overall a short video sharing platform on which anyone can make videos and share it on TikTok for others to see.

reviews.title: Easy to make, fun to watch.
reviews.pros:
- It automatically read your preferences and only shows relevant videos.

- The making of videos on Tik Tok is very easy and a fun process.

- It can be a potential career option for people with talent to showcase.
reviews.cons: - Sometimes some videos get shown repeatedly, even after reporting as "not interested".
reviews.overall: Overall, Tik Tok is a fun video sharing and creating a platform that can be used by anyone from any age group.

reviews.title: Very Addictive!!
reviews.pros:
Easy Access

User friendly 

Short videos

Users across the globe

Free application

Tiktok is one of the most simple and popular apps
reviews.cons: There are stories that they have access to most of your privacy as per the terms and agreements. This is something I am not sure of. But it is one of the most addictive applications,
reviews.overall: I would definitely recommend this to a friend 10/10. But the application was banned in my country a few weeks back. But it is still an amazing application used by most of the users in the world.

reviews.title: Stress buster app
reviews.pros: Tiktok app is very much mobile friendly build. I loved the way of sharing short size video to across the globe. UI is clean and polished.
reviews.cons: In many research I heard that TikTok is not safe for users. So I'm little cautious about my data safety.
reviews.overall: Overall TikTok is good entertainment app. I use this app to remove my work stress. I liked the skip login option I suggest this option if you just want to watch videos.

reviews.title: Addictive App
reviews.pros: I am using TikTok to promote my own brand and also enjoy videos from creative people.  The application is a self-starter and you do not need to press any button to see videos.  There is very little searching is involved, The video creation process is very easy and has some good features which allow you to be more creative.
reviews.cons: It can become addictive if you do not use it with consciousness. The application have some serious policy issues, Many people create videos which are not beneficial for the society and needs to be taken down. The support system and video quality checking need to be improved.
reviews.overall: If you know the purpose of using this application then this is a fun application to have on your mobile phone. There are many talented people on this platform and they are inspirational.

reviews.title: FUN!
reviews.pros: Fun way to show short videos that are humorous and enjoyable to watch. Easy to play videos on it too.
reviews.cons: I don't like how when it first opens it starts playing.
reviews.overall: Overall it's a good tool and works really easily. It's mostly young people on it so if you're marketing you can reach them.
